title_zh: 说明临时安置点毛毯短缺并请求库存核对

scenario.label_zh: 风暴安置点物资短缺沟通
scenario.goal_zh: 说明场地受损与安置点毛毯缺口，约定向仓库询问库存后回报是否能够供货

context_zh: 虚构应急沟通练习中，两位社区工作人员协调风暴后的物资，不提供真实灾情或现场救援指令。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: The severe storm has forced more families to leave their homes. Can we use the school hall?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: No. The roof was severely damaged. The sports centre is the temporary shelter listed on our update.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: The team there reports a shortage of blankets. They have twelve, but they need twenty.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: So they are asking for eight more. I can check the supply warehouse.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Please do, but do not promise a delivery before you know what is available.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Understood. I'll ask about stock and transport, then call you with a confirmed answer.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll tell the shelter team we are checking, not that the blankets are already on the way.
